name: FedCon
blurb: Europe's largest Star Trek and science-fiction convention, three days of star guests, autographs and a cosplay catwalk at the Maritim Hotel Bonn.

editions.evidence: Homepage: 'FedCon 35 – triff vom 14.05. - 16.05.2027 im Maritim Hotel Bonn deine Lieblingsstars...' and 'Die Gaststars 2027: Robert Picardo, Brent Spiner, Terry Farrell, Callum Keith Rennie, Kate Mulgrew, Jonathan Frakes, Marina Sirtis, Gates McFadden, Nicole de Boer'.

notes: Guest cards on the homepage carry only each actor's name with no credit text rendered on the card itself, so known-for is left blank per the rules rather than filled from outside knowledge; cat is 'actor' for all nine since each is a known live-action film/TV performer (all are Star Trek alumni except Callum Keith Rennie, best known for Battlestar Galactica).
